selected_config.reason: Fastest measured vLLM TP=2 no-MTP fanout lane after the custom-transfer config attempts.

attempts.blocker_detail: vLLM startup failed: at least one 200000-token request required 13.83 GiB KV cache, but only 6.07 GiB was available; estimated max model length was 15104.

do_not_apply: Do not raise max_num_batched_tokens above 8192 for the 200k-context Spark4/Spark5 TP=2 lane without retesting KV capacity.
Do not add --no-enable-prefix-caching for this mixed fanout lane.
Do not use max_model_len=8192 for 512-way fanout; it reduced KV token capacity too far.
conclusion.next_code_change: A real vLLM improvement requires an actual candidate-only output path or a DeepSeek-V4 MoE backend equivalent to the custom DS4 slice-tile8 path; config-only transfers did not reproduce the custom speedup.
